aarti.pad1: You are the protector of the lowly and the sorrowful, the one who cuts away the troubles of the world. He is the warrior servant of Bālājī: bow to him with all your heart. ॥1॥
aarti.pad2: He whose feet never knew defeat, who came down for Śrī Rāma's work: to his service you give your mind. Hear the petition of your servant. ॥2॥
aarti.pad3: You are obedient to Bābā, and you ride on an elephant; ghosts and jinns all shake and tremble. Put the petition to Bābā. ॥3॥
aarti.pad4: Jinns and all the rest, out of fear, lie at your door rubbing their noses on the ground. Cut away my troubles at once; take this prayer to heart. ॥4॥
aarti.pad5: Your royal attire is splendid; O merciful one, the shield and the bow are most pleasing. I have come to your refuge: carry my boat across. ॥5॥
